verdict.rationale: BigCommerce offers building blocks for background automation: webhooks, including Google Cloud Pub/Sub delivery, fire on store events, and its APIs are described as letting you 'automate store processes'. Autonomous behavior, however, has to be built and hosted by the user through custom integrations or third-party apps, not configured natively. Missing for 10: a native automation or workflow builder, AI/agent-driven autonomous tasks, scheduled jobs, documented examples of end-to-end background automations, and independent corroboration.
